Assign Koppen-Geiger Climate Zones to Brazilian Municipalities

Source: R/sus_grid_koppen.R
sus_grid_koppen.Rd

Adds a zona_koppen column with a municipality-level Koppen-Geiger climate class (after Alvares et al. (2013), the 1 km Koppen map for Brazil) to a climasus_df, data.frame or sf object. Use it at any pipeline stage after a code_muni column exists (typically after sus_spatial_join()) to obtain a climate-zone covariate or stratifier for sus_mod_dlnm() / sus_mod_casecrossover(). It does not change sus_meta stage or type (only a history entry is added). Note: "approx" uses simplified state/centroid rules (approximate, not the original raster).

Usage

sus_grid_koppen(
  data,
  mode = "approx",
  koppen_sf = NULL,
  as_factor = TRUE,
  lang = "pt",
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

data

A climasus_df, data.frame or sf object with a code_muni column (6- or 7-digit IBGE code, character or numeric; the 7th digit is ignored). Other classes, or a missing code_muni, error. sf input is returned as a plain tibble without geometry.

mode

Character scalar. "approx" (default): rule-based assignment from municipality centroids in the bundled municipio_meta table (no extra packages). "exact": spatial join of those centroids to koppen_sf (requires sf). Any other value errors.

koppen_sf

An sf polygon object with a column named koppen holding the zone codes (e.g. "Af", "Aw", "Cf"). Required for mode = "exact" (error if missing or without a koppen column); ignored for "approx". Reprojected to EPSG:4326 if needed. With as_factor = TRUE, codes outside the seven levels below (e.g. "Cfa", "Cwb") become NA; use as_factor = FALSE to keep detailed codes. Reference publication: https://doi.org/10.1127/0941-2948/2013/0507.

as_factor

Logical scalar. If TRUE (default) zona_koppen is an ordered factor with levels Af < Am < As < Aw < BSh < Cf < Cw; if FALSE a character column. Municipalities without a match are NA (a warning is printed).

lang

Character scalar. Message language: "pt" (default), "en" or "es". Unsupported values fall back to "pt" with a warning.

verbose

Logical scalar. Print progress messages. Default TRUE.

Value

The input rows with an additional column zona_koppen (ordered factor or character, see as_factor). A climasus_df input keeps its class and sus_meta (stage/system unchanged, history updated); a data.frame or sf input returns a tibble.

Details

Two assignment modes are available:

  • "approx" (default): rule-based assignment from municipality centroid coordinates stored in the built-in municipio_meta table. Fast and dependency-free, with ~85% accuracy at the municipal level.

  • "exact": spatial join between municipality centroids and a user- supplied sf polygon layer (koppen_sf). Produces exact results when the original Alvares et al. (2013) shapefile is provided.

Koppen zones for Brazil (Alvares et al. 2013)

Af

Tropical humid (equatorial) – Amazon / NE coast.

Am

Tropical monsoon – North / Center-West.

As

Tropical summer dry – NE coast.

Aw

Tropical winter dry (savanna) – Central Brazil.

BSh

Hot semi-arid – NE sertao.

Cf

Subtropical humid – South / coastal SE.

Cw

Subtropical winter dry – SE plateau / Center-West uplands.

References

Alvares, C.A., Stape, J.L., Sentelhas, P.C., Goncalves, J.L.M., & Sparovek, G. (2013). Koppen's climate classification map for Brazil. Meteorologische Zeitschrift, 22(6), 711-728. doi:10.1127/0941-2948/2013/0507

See also

sus_spatial_join(), sus_grid_era5(), sus_mod_casecrossover(), sus_mod_dlnm()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
library(climasus4r)

# With a climasus_df that has code_muni
df_with_koppen <- sus_grid_koppen(df_aggregated, mode = "approx")
table(df_with_koppen$zona_koppen)

# Exact mode with Alvares et al. 2013 shapefile
library(sf)
kop_sf <- sf::read_sf("koppen_brazil_alvares2013.shp")
names(kop_sf)[names(kop_sf) == "zone"] <- "koppen"  # rename if needed
df_exact <- sus_grid_koppen(df_aggregated, mode = "exact", koppen_sf = kop_sf)
} # }
